heritage-recommendation.description: Standard heritage recommendation certificate for listed places

versions.changelog: Original template migrated from legacy naming
Updated header layout and formatting
Added Lot on Plan field, fixed formatting issues
Fixed formatting, removed footer, removed map co-ordinates

Fixed names, criteria, descriptions and images not rendering: Arches concept fields are lists, so comparisons now use membership ('X' in field) instead of equality, and Word smart quotes in Jinja tags were replaced with straight quotes.

Fixed place ID (system reference number) and place name not rendering: placeholder now reads system_reference_numbers.primaryreferencenumber.primary_reference_number instead of the empty uuid.resourceid; place name now prefers the Primary monument name and falls back to the first name when no use-type is set. Image captions now pull from the caption node.
